description:
"The Political Barbecue". 1834 cartoon depicting Andrew Jackson being roasted over the fires of opinion.

Andrew Jackson is roasted over the fires of "Public Opinion" by the figure of Justice in a cartoon relating to the controversy surrounding Jackson's removal of federal deposits from the Bank of the United States. Jackson, with the body of a pig, is prone on a gridiron over a stone barbecue ove
